name: hd_fs30_v2
notes: HD free spectrum re-run after review (hd_fs30 not converged). Independent, overdispersed initialisation: every coordinate z ~ U(-4, 4) in the unconstrained logistic parameterisation (uniform in z, not in the prior box; starts within 1.8-98.2% of every prior range); nothing taken from curn_fs30 or any other run (init and metric). Diagonal windowed adaptation as a baseline (not a funnel remedy). Acceptance: scripts/m2_freespec_diag.py --run hd_fs30_v2 must exit 0 (ptagwb.diagnostics.freespec_gate: all 164 parameters R-hat < 1.01 and bulk/tail ESS >= 400; per-bin occupancy indicator R-hat < 1.01, ESS >= 400, |z| vs released <= 3.5; tail stability |z| <= 4.5). Run with scripts/m2_rerun_fs30.sh.
